newsitem.title: INDIA: India to accept company share buybacks.
newsitem.headline: India to accept company share buybacks.

text.p: India plans to accept the principle of buyback of shares by companies, subject to certain conditions, Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Friday.
The minister in his budget proposals for 1997/98 (April-March) said that buybacks of shares would be allowed under a new company law for which a legislative bill would be introduced in parliament.
Managements of Indian companies have been lobbying the government for permission to buy back shares of their companies in an effort to ward off possible takeovers.
The new law would also make it mandatory for companies raising funds from the capital market to give an annual statement on the end-use of such funds, Chidambaram said.
